entry.title: Rumeli Hisarı

terrainReference.basis: Own attributed Terrarium sample grid: source Y0 is the grid minimum -2.29m; anchor sample is21.34m. Host terrain sampler must use a consistent datum and subtract23.63m native anchor height. Coarse grid and original foundation pads are not surveyed terraces.

entry.note: Exact Q90801 fortress relation, +X east toward Bosphorus, +Z south. Raw map-member roles appear reversed; larger tower contour is interpreted as the site, smaller ring as the open court. Three independently authored stepped towers, mapped minor bastions and mosque envelope; gates, square defenses and forecourt are photographic estimates. Extent covers all LODs plus2cm; terrain reference permits consistent host placement. Current-state architecture, real terrain/datum blending and site fidelity remain unverified. Inactive draft; no footprint replacement.
